mapper.select: select (select count(*) from blog_article) as article_total, (select count(*) from blog_draft where status = '0') as draft_total, (select count(*) from blog_talk) as talk_total

select date_format(date(publish_date), '%Y-%m-%d') as d_date, count(*) as cnt from blog_article where publish_date is not null and date(publish_date) between #{startDate} and #{endDate} group by date_format(date(publish_date), '%Y-%m-%d')

select date_format(date(create_time), '%Y-%m-%d') as d_date, count(*) as cnt from blog_draft where status = '0' and create_time is not null and date(create_time) between #{startDate} and #{endDate} group by date_format(date(create_time), '%Y-%m-%d')

select date_format(date(create_time), '%Y-%m-%d') as d_date, count(*) as cnt from blog_talk where create_time is not null and date(create_time) between #{startDate} and #{endDate} group by date_format(date(create_time), '%Y-%m-%d')
select categories from blog_article where categories is not null and categories != ''
select count(*) from blog_link where link_type = '2'
select count(*) from blog_link where link_type = '2' and last_error is not null and last_error != ''
select max(last_sync_time) from blog_link where link_type = '2'
select link_name as link_name, last_error as last_error from blog_link where link_type = '2' and last_error is not null and last_error != '' order by last_sync_time desc limit #{limit}
select count(*) from blog_draft where status = '0'
select count(*) from blog_article where create_by = #{createBy}
